name: open_cleanup_reveal
description: Rule-reveal ablation, one trial: every agent is given the true recipes (which pick-up order makes which working tool and what it does) at the start. Homogeneous populations of Claude Opus 5.5, gpt-6-sol, GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-27B, seeds 906-908.
about: Setting and model specs copied verbatim from experiments/open_cleanup_5ag/config.json, except stop_after_trials = 1 (outer stays 5, so the prompt and the environment match the formal runs; the run ends after trial 1) and reveal_orders = true. Compare with trial 1 of the formal runs on the same seeds (same map, rules and hues; the only difference is that the rules are given). Prompts unchanged; the ledger says the given rules are true.

claude-opus-5.5.thinking: default effort (medium); no structured output (refused as reasoning_extraction)
